assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D desktop-pet animation sprite atlas for 灵境. Create one square transparent PNG with an EXACT 4 column by 4 row equal-cell grid, sixteen full-body poses of ONE original chibi ivory-white cat with small soft-gray ear tips, clear blue eyes, a mist-blue ribbon collar and tiny four-point star charm. Warm hand-painted anime illustration, soft cream/mist-blue palette, rounded paws and fluffy tail, polished consistent linework matching a gentle Chinese desktop companion game. Every cat centered within its own equal square cell, same size and baseline, generous transparent gutters, all ears/tail/effects inside the cell. Faces three-quarter right. Real alpha background, completely transparent outside art. No text, labels, numbers, border, checkerboard, ground plane, cast shadow, UI, extra characters, watermarks, or cell backgrounds. Do not merge cells.
